description: One agent's budget as list_my_budgets shows it, read from the chain now, with the owner's last action for it (setup, grant, revoke or fund) and whether that is final. revoke says whether the latest revoke on record is final, in a block but not final yet, or unknown. Treat a revoke as done, and a new grant as usable, only once it is final. Moves no funds.

agent.description: The id of an agent from list_my_budgets

name: get_budget_status
title: Get a budget's status
